title: The incised hand and its metrics font
source: Drawn for this component; font built by tools/build-font.py with fontTools
note: Single-stroke letterforms after the cursive scratched into wax tablets (the Met tablet's own Greek leaf, Vindolanda stylus tablets, the Pompeian tablets of Caecilius Iucundus): angular turns, long ascenders and descenders, each stroke entering blunt and lifting to a hairline. Kept legible as English. The font has no outlines, only advances.
